title: Coordination of Benefits Bulletin - Other Insurer Payments on Corrected TRICARE Select Outpatient Lines
content:
**Rule.** On a corrected **TRICARE Select** outpatient line, where other health insurance is on file for the enrollee and the other insurer paid at least the allowed amount of the line, nothing of a corrected outpatient line is left to cost-share; where other health insurance is on file and the other insurer paid some but less than the allowed amount, the amount of a corrected outpatient line left to cost-share is the allowed amount less that payment; otherwise the amount left to cost-share is the allowed amount. The amount left to cost-share is the amount the line's deductible and cost share are figured on.

The other insurer's payment is the other-insurance payment recorded on the reversed line; whether other health insurance is on file is read from the enrollee's Select enrollment.

## Condition - result

| Other health insurance on file | Other insurer's payment on the line | Amount left to cost-share |
|---|---|---|
| yes | equal to or more than the allowed amount | nothing (0.00) |
| yes | more than zero, less than the allowed amount | the allowed amount less that payment |
| yes | none | the allowed amount |
| no | any | the allowed amount |

## Hypothetical lines (allowed amount 300.00)

- Other health insurance on file, other insurer paid 300.00 (or 320.00): nothing is left to cost-share.
- Other health insurance on file, other insurer paid 299.99: 0.01 is left to cost-share.
- Other health insurance on file, other insurer paid 120.00: 180.00 is left to cost-share.
- No other health insurance on file: 300.00 is left to cost-share, whatever payment figure appears on the line.
